```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

#to make the renv intially
#renv::init()

#renv friendly loading of packages.
#dont use pacman for this as it may overwrite the version of the package used in renv
required_packages <- c("tidyverse", "here", "renv","Hmisc","mice")

missing <- required_packages[!sapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  stop("Missing packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), 
       ". Please run renv::restore() to install them.")
}
#if a package isnt installed in renv::restore(), do this: 
#renv::install("tidyverse")

library(renv)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(Hmisc)
library(mice)

#record-level corrections and per-protocol ids, kept with the restricted data
source(here("Programs","record_corrections.R"))

```

# Analysis phase 1

## Read in the initial data
```{r}
breast_init <- readRDS(here("Data","breast_init.RDS"))
breast_active_init <- readRDS(here("Data","breast_active_init.RDS")) %>% dplyr::select(-redcap_event_name,-redcap_event_name.factor)
```

## Data cleaning
```{r}
breast <- breast_init %>%
  group_by(record_id) %>%
  #data across 2 rows but dont share columns, can keep 1 row only
  tidyr::fill(everything(),.direction="downup") %>%
  filter(redcap_event_name.factor == "Baseline") %>%
  merge(breast_active_init,by="record_id") %>%
  #drop columns that are empty and not needed columns
  dplyr::select(where(~sum(!is.na(.x)) > 0),
                -qor1.factor,-qor2.factor,-qor3.factor,-qor4.factor,-qor5.factor,
                -qor6.factor,-qor7.factor,-qor8.factor,-qor9.factor,-qor10.factor,
                -qor11.factor,-qor12.factor,-qor13.factor,-qor14.factor,-qor15.factor,
                -sex,-country_born,-aboriginal_tso_origin,-other_language_home.factor,
                -education,-live_with___1.factor,-live_with___0.factor,
                -live_with___2.factor,-live_with___3.factor,-live_with___98.factor,
                -live_with___99.factor,-overnight_stay.factor,-assess_pca.factor,
                -employment_yn.factor,-hlth_ins_0.factor,-previous_surgery.factor,
                -internet_time,-ppt_postcode,-recruited_from,-actual_surgery_date,
                -discharged_date,-surgery_type,-live_with___98,-aria_code,
                -assess_understand_enhance) %>%
  rename(spouse_partner = live_with___1,
         children = live_with___2,
         other_family = live_with___3,
         on_own = live_with___0) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.factor), fct_drop)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.factor), ~{x <- .
                                  x[x == "Missing"] <- NA
                                  droplevels(x)})) %>%
  mutate(country_born.factor = case_when(country_born.factor == "Other {country_born_other}" ~ "Other",
                                      .default=country_born.factor),
         treatment = factor(treatment_group),
         meals_bin = case_when(assess_meals_eaten %in% c(1,2) ~ 0,
                               assess_meals_eaten %in% c(3) ~ 1),
         snacks_bin = case_when(snacks_hosp %in% c(0,1,2) ~ 0,
                                snacks_hosp %in% c(3) ~ 1),
         liquid_bin = case_when(assess_liquid >= 4 ~ 1,
                                assess_liquid < 4 ~ 0),
         qor_tot = qor1+qor2+qor3+qor4+qor5+qor6+qor7+qor8+qor9+qor10+qor11+qor12+
                   qor13+qor14+qor15) %>%
  correct_records() %>%
  mutate(per_protocol = as.integer(record_id %in% pp_ids))
label(breast$qor_tot) <- "qor_tot"

saveRDS(breast,here("Data","breast.RDS"))

```

## Imputation
```{r}
breast_miss <- breast %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(record_id,treatment,assess_walk_num,los,assess_pca,assess_meals_eaten,
                snacks_hosp,assess_liquid,assess_exercises,
                assess_understand_enhance.factor,
                qor1,qor2,qor3,qor4,qor5,qor6,qor7,qor8,qor9,qor10,qor11,qor12,
                qor13,qor14,qor15,
                master_age,aria_code.factor,surgery_type.factor,
                employment_yn,previous_surgery,spouse_partner,children,on_own,
                minutes_out_of_bed,minutes_walking_moving)
imp <- mice::mice(breast_miss, m = 15, print = FALSE,method="pmm",maxit=50,seed=487103578,
            pred=quickpred(breast_miss,include=c("treatment","surgery_type.factor"),
                           exclude=c("record_id","assess_pca"),
                           minpuc = 0.2,mincor=0.4,method="spearman"))
densityplot(imp)
plot(imp)

test <- imp[["loggedEvents"]]
breast_imp <- complete(imp,action="long") %>%
  mutate(qor_tot = qor1+qor2+qor3+qor4+qor5+qor6+qor7+qor8+qor9+qor10+qor11+qor12+
                   qor13+qor14+qor15,
         meals_bin = case_when(assess_meals_eaten %in% c(1,2) ~ 0,
                               assess_meals_eaten %in% c(3) ~ 1),
         snacks_bin = case_when(snacks_hosp %in% c(0,1,2) ~ 0,
                                snacks_hosp %in% c(3) ~ 1),
         liquid_bin = case_when(assess_liquid >= 4 ~ 1,
                                assess_liquid < 4 ~ 0),
         how_bin = case_when(assess_understand_enhance.factor %in% c("A","SA") ~ 1,
                             assess_understand_enhance.factor %in% c("N","D","SD") ~ 0)) %>%
  left_join(breast %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(record_id,per_protocol),by="record_id")

saveRDS(breast_imp,here("Data","breast_imp.RDS"))
```

los = los
pca device = assess_pca
meals = assess_meals_eaten
snacks = snacks_hosp
fluids = assess_liquid
time out of bed = minutes_out_of_bed
time spent moving = minutes_walking_moving
times walked = assess_walk_num
times physio = assess_exercises
how to enhance own recovery = assess_understand_enhance.factor
QOR = sum of qors

# Analysis phase 2

## Read in the data

```{r}
br_p2_init <- readRDS(here("Data","br_p2_init.RDS"))
```

## Data cleaning

```{r}
br_p2 <- br_p2_init %>%
  dplyr::select(-redcap_event_name,

                -hads_forward.factor,-hads_panic.factor,-hads_book.factor,
                -qor1.factor,-qor2.factor,-qor3.factor,-qor4.factor,-qor5.factor,
                -qor6.factor,-qor7.factor,-qor8.factor,-qor9.factor,-qor10.factor,

                -ae_fall_yn,-ae_pain_yn,-ae_anxiety_yn,

br_p2_imp1 <- br_p2 %>%

              values_from = c(q1,q2,q3,q4,q5,q6,q7,q8,q9,q10,q11,q12,q13,q14,q15,q16,q17,q18,q19,
                q20,q21,q22,q23,q24,q25,q26,q27,q28,q29,q30,
                qor1,qor2,qor3,qor4,qor5,qor6,qor7,qor8,qor9,qor10,qor11,qor12,qor13,qor14,qor15,
                hads_tense,hads_awful,hads_worry,hads_relaxed,hads_butterflies,
                hads_restless,hads_panic,
                hads_enjoy,hads_laugh,hads_cheerful,hads_slowed,hads_appearance,

                services_total_cost,ed_presentations_3mo,admissions_3mo,nights_admitted_3mo)) %>%

  mutate(`ed_presentations_3mo_3 month fup` = ifelse(is.na(`ed_presentations_3mo_3 month fup`),0,`ed_presentations_3mo_3 month fup`),
         `admissions_3mo_3 month fup` = ifelse(is.na(`admissions_3mo_3 month fup`),0,`admissions_3mo_3 month fup`),

  dplyr::select(record_id,master_age,treatment,surgery_type.factor) %>%
```

## calculating scores for the non imputed dataset
```{r}
br_p2_1 <- br_p2 %>%
  mutate(hads_anxiety = hads_tense + hads_awful + hads_worry + hads_relaxed + hads_butterflies + hads_restless + hads_panic,
         hads_depress = hads_enjoy + hads_laugh + hads_cheerful + hads_slowed + hads_appearance + hads_forward + hads_book,
         qor_tot = qor1+qor2+qor3+qor4+qor5+qor6+qor7+qor8+qor9+qor10+qor11+qor12+qor13+qor14+qor15,
         ae_fall_yn = case_when(ae_fall_yn.factor == "Yes" ~ 1,
                                ae_fall_yn.factor == "No" ~ 0),
         ae_anxiety_yn = case_when(ae_anxiety_yn.factor == "Yes" ~ 1,
                                   ae_anxiety_yn.factor == "No" ~ 0),
         ae_pain_yn = case_when(ae_pain_yn.factor == "Yes" ~ 1,
                                ae_pain_yn.factor == "No" ~ 0))

br_p2_2 <- br_p2_1 %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(QL2_raw = sum(across(q29:q30))/2) %>% 
  mutate(QL2 = (QL2_raw - 1)/6*100) %>% 
  #Functional scales
  #mutate(PF2_miss = sum(is.na(across(a1:a5)))) %>% 
  mutate(PF2_raw = sum(across(q1:q5))/sum(!is.na(across(q1:q5)))) %>% 
  mutate(PF2 = (1-(PF2_raw-1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(RF2_raw = sum(across(q6:q7))/2) %>% 
  mutate(RF2 = (1-(RF2_raw-1)/3)*100) %>% 
  #mutate(EF_miss = sum(is.na(across(a21:a24)))) %>%
  mutate(EF_raw = sum(across(q21:q24))/sum(!is.na(across(q21:q24)))) %>% 
  mutate(EF = (1-(EF_raw-1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(CF_raw = sum(across(c(q20, q25)))/2) %>% 
  mutate(CF = (1-(CF_raw-1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(SF_raw = sum(across(c(q26, q27)))/2) %>% 
  mutate(SF = (1-(SF_raw-1)/3)*100) %>% 
  #Symptom scales
  #mutate(FA_miss = sum(is.na(across(c(a10, a12, a18))))) %>% 
  mutate(FA_raw = sum(across(c(q10, q12, q18)))/sum(!is.na(across(c(q10, q12, q18))))) %>% 
  mutate(FA = (FA_raw - 1)/3*100) %>% 
  mutate(FA_rev =(1-(FA_raw - 1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(NV_raw = sum(across(c(q14,q15))/2)) %>% 
  mutate(NV = (NV_raw - 1)/3*100) %>% 
  mutate(NV_rev =(1-(NV_raw - 1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(PA_raw = sum(across(c(q9,q19))/2)) %>% 
  mutate(PA = (PA_raw - 1)/3*100) %>% 
  mutate(PA_rev = (1 - (PA_raw - 1)/3)*100) %>%
  mutate(DY = (q8-1)/3*100) %>% 
  mutate(DY_rev = (1 - (q8-1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(SL = (q11-1)/3*100) %>%
  mutate(SL_rev = (1 - (q11-1)/3)*100) %>%
  mutate(AP = (q13-1)/3*100) %>%
  mutate(AP_rev = (1 - (q13-1)/3)*100) %>%
  mutate(CO = (q16-1)/3*100) %>%
  mutate(CO_rev = (1-(q16-1)/3)*100) %>%
  mutate(DI = (q17-1)/3*100) %>%
  mutate(DI_rev = (1 - (q17-1)/3)*100) %>%
  mutate(FI = (q28-1)/3*100) %>% 
  mutate(summary_score = sum(across(c(PF2, RF2, EF, CF, SF,
                                    FA_rev, NV_rev, PA_rev, DY_rev, SL_rev, AP_rev, CO_rev, DI_rev)))/13) %>%  dplyr::select(-q1,-q2,-q3,-q4,-q5,-q6,-q7,-q8,-q9,-q10,-q11,-q12,-q13,-q14,-q15,
                -q16,-q17,-q18,-q19,-q20,-q21,-q22,-q23,-q24,-q25,-q26,-q27,-q28,
                -q29,-q30,
                -QL2_raw,-PF2_raw,-RF2_raw,-EF_raw,-CF_raw,
                -SF_raw,-FA_raw,-NV_raw,-PA_raw,-FA_rev,-NV_rev,-PA_rev,
                -DY_rev,-SL_rev,-AP_rev,-CO_rev,-DI_rev,
                -hads_tense,-hads_awful,-hads_worry,-hads_relaxed,-hads_butterflies,-hads_restless,-hads_panic,
                -hads_enjoy,-hads_laugh,-hads_cheerful,-hads_slowed,-hads_appearance,-hads_forward,-hads_book,
                -qor1,-qor2,-qor3,-qor4,-qor5,-qor6,-qor7,-qor8,-qor9,-qor10,
                -qor11,-qor12,-qor13,-qor14,-qor15)

breast_p1 <- readRDS(here("Data","breast.RDS")) %>%
  dplyr::select(record_id,master_age,treatment,surgery_type.factor) %>%
           mutate(surgery_final = case_when(surgery_type.factor %in% c("Mastectomy and delayed reconstruction","Mastectomy - no reconstruction") ~ 1,
                                   surgery_type.factor == "Mastectomy and immediate reconstruction" ~ 0))
br_p2_3 <- merge(breast_p1,br_p2_2,by="record_id")

saveRDS(br_p2_3,here("Data","br_p2.RDS"))
```



## Imputation second dataset

```{r}
#getting the predictor matrix
imp <- mice::mice(br_p2_imp2, m = 1, print = FALSE,method="pmm",maxit=50,seed=487103578,
            pred=quickpred(br_p2_imp2,include=c("treatment","surgery_type.factor"),
                           minpuc = 0.2,mincor=0.6,method="spearman"))

test <- imp[["loggedEvents"]]
predmat <- imp[["predictorMatrix"]]

#mice cannot impute variables with a single observed value,
#so set the missing values to the observed value for those variables
item_vars <- grep("^(q[0-9]|qor|hads_)", names(br_p2_imp2), value = TRUE)
const_vars <- item_vars[sapply(br_p2_imp2[item_vars], \(x) anyNA(x) && n_distinct(na.omit(x)) == 1)]
br_p2_imp2[const_vars] <- lapply(br_p2_imp2[const_vars], \(x) replace(x, is.na(x), unique(na.omit(x))))
#small sample so have to reduce number of variables used to predict
#set no predictors except treatment and surgery type
predmat[] <- 0
predmat[,"treatment"] <- 1
predmat[,"surgery_type.factor"] <- 1
predmat["treatment","treatment"] <- 0
predmat["surgery_type.factor","surgery_type.factor"] <- 0

#add in the other times of that variable to predict matrix
for (i in 1:30) {
  predmat[paste0("q", i, "_Baseline"), paste0("q", i, "_1 month fup")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("q", i, "_Baseline"), paste0("q", i, "_3 month fup")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("q", i, "_1 month fup"), paste0("q", i, "_Baseline")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("q", i, "_1 month fup"), paste0("q", i, "_3 month fup")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("q", i, "_3 month fup"), paste0("q", i, "_Baseline")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("q", i, "_3 month fup"), paste0("q", i, "_1 month fup")] <- 1
}
#add in the other times of that variable to predict matrix
for (i in 1:15) {
  predmat[paste0("qor", i, "_Admission"), paste0("qor", i, "_1 month fup")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("qor", i, "_Admission"), paste0("qor", i, "_3 month fup")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("qor", i, "_1 month fup"), paste0("qor", i, "_Admission")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("qor", i, "_1 month fup"), paste0("qor", i, "_3 month fup")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("qor", i, "_3 month fup"), paste0("qor", i, "_Admission")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("qor", i, "_3 month fup"), paste0("qor", i, "_1 month fup")] <- 1
}

for (i in c("tense","awful","worry","relaxed","butterflies","restless","panic",
            "enjoy","laugh","cheerful","slowed","appearance","forward","book")){
  predmat[paste0("hads_", i, "_Baseline"), paste0("hads_", i, "_1 month fup")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("hads_", i, "_Baseline"), paste0("hads_", i, "_3 month fup")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("hads_", i, "_1 month fup"), paste0("hads_", i, "_Baseline")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("hads_", i, "_1 month fup"), paste0("hads_", i, "_3 month fup")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("hads_", i, "_3 month fup"), paste0("hads_", i, "_Baseline")] <- 1
  predmat[paste0("hads_", i, "_3 month fup"), paste0("hads_", i, "_1 month fup")] <- 1
}
#the actual imputation
imp <- mice::mice(br_p2_imp2, m = 15, print = FALSE,method="pmm",maxit=50,seed=487103578,
            predictorMatrix=predmat)
test <- imp[["loggedEvents"]]
#hads_restless is not using the other time points but all other vars are fine. 
br_p2_imp <- complete(imp,action="long")
#pivot the data back to long form
br_p2_imp_1 <- br_p2_imp %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(record_id,treatment,master_age,surgery_type.factor,.imp,.id),
               names_to = c(".value", "redcap_event_name.factor"),
               names_pattern = "(.+)_(Baseline|Admission|1 month fup|3 month fup)$")
```

## calculate scores post imputation

```{r}
br_p2_imp_2 <- br_p2_imp_1 %>%
  mutate(hads_anxiety = hads_tense + hads_awful + hads_worry + hads_relaxed + hads_butterflies + hads_restless + hads_panic,
         hads_depress = hads_enjoy + hads_laugh + hads_cheerful + hads_slowed + hads_appearance + hads_forward + hads_book,
         qor_tot = qor1+qor2+qor3+qor4+qor5+qor6+qor7+qor8+qor9+qor10+qor11+qor12+qor13+qor14+qor15)

br_p2_imp_3 <- br_p2_imp_2 %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  #Global Health status/QoL
  mutate(QL2_raw = sum(across(q29:q30))/2) %>% 
  mutate(QL2 = (QL2_raw - 1)/6*100) %>% 
  #Functional scales
  mutate(PF2_miss = sum(is.na(across(q1:q5)))) %>% 
  mutate(PF2_raw = if_else(PF2_miss < 2.5, sum(across(q1:q5), na.rm=T)/sum(!is.na(across(q1:q5))), NA)) %>% 
  mutate(PF2 = (1-(PF2_raw-1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(RF2_raw = sum(across(q6:q7))/2) %>% 
  mutate(RF2 = (1-(RF2_raw-1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(EF_miss = sum(is.na(across(q21:q24)))) %>%
  mutate(EF_raw = if_else(EF_miss < 2.5, sum(across(q21:q24), na.rm=T)/sum(!is.na(across(q21:q24))), NA)) %>% 
  mutate(EF = (1-(EF_raw-1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(CF_raw = sum(across(c(q20, q25)))/2) %>% 
  mutate(CF = (1-(CF_raw-1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(SF_raw = sum(across(c(q26, q27)))/2) %>% 
  mutate(SF = (1-(SF_raw-1)/3)*100) %>% 
  #Symptom scales
  mutate(FA_miss = sum(is.na(across(c(q10, q12, q18))))) %>% 
  mutate(FA_raw = if_else(FA_miss < 1.5, sum(across(c(q10, q12, q18)), na.rm=T)/sum(!is.na(across(c(q10, q12, q18)))), NA)) %>% 
  mutate(FA = (FA_raw - 1)/3*100) %>% 
  mutate(FA_rev =(1-(FA_raw - 1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(NV_raw = sum(across(c(q14,q15))/2)) %>% 
  mutate(NV = (NV_raw - 1)/3*100) %>% 
  mutate(NV_rev =(1-(NV_raw - 1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(PA_raw = sum(across(c(q9,q19))/2)) %>% 
  mutate(PA = (PA_raw - 1)/3*100) %>% 
  mutate(PA_rev = (1 - (PA_raw - 1)/3)*100) %>%
  mutate(DY = (q8-1)/3*100) %>% 
  mutate(DY_rev = (1 - (q8-1)/3)*100) %>% 
  mutate(SL = (q11-1)/3*100) %>%
  mutate(SL_rev = (1 - (q11-1)/3)*100) %>%
  mutate(AP = (q13-1)/3*100) %>%
  mutate(AP_rev = (1 - (q13-1)/3)*100) %>%
  mutate(CO = (q16-1)/3*100) %>%
  mutate(CO_rev = (1-(q16-1)/3)*100) %>%
  mutate(DI = (q17-1)/3*100) %>%
  mutate(DI_rev = (1 - (q17-1)/3)*100) %>%
  mutate(FI = (q28-1)/3*100) %>% 
  mutate(summary_score = sum(across(c(PF2, RF2, EF, CF, SF,
                                    FA_rev, NV_rev, PA_rev, DY_rev, SL_rev, AP_rev, CO_rev, DI_rev)))/13) %>%
  dplyr::select(-q1,-q2,-q3,-q4,-q5,-q6,-q7,-q8,-q9,-q10,-q11,-q12,-q13,-q14,-q15,
                -q16,-q17,-q18,-q19,-q20,-q21,-q22,-q23,-q24,-q25,-q26,-q27,-q28,
                -q29,-q30,-.id,
                -PF2_miss,-QL2_raw,-PF2_raw,-RF2_raw,-EF_miss,-EF_raw,-CF_raw,
                -SF_raw,-FA_miss,-FA_raw,-NV_raw,-PA_raw,-FA_rev,-NV_rev,-PA_rev,
                -DY_rev,-SL_rev,-AP_rev,-CO_rev,-DI_rev,
                -hads_tense,-hads_awful,-hads_worry,-hads_relaxed,-hads_butterflies,-hads_restless,-hads_panic,
                -hads_enjoy,-hads_laugh,-hads_cheerful,-hads_slowed,-hads_appearance,-hads_forward,-hads_book,
                -qor1,-qor2,-qor3,-qor4,-qor5,-qor6,-qor7,-qor8,-qor9,-qor10,
                -qor11,-qor12,-qor13,-qor14,-qor15)
```
